text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of Air Groove's debut. Mejiro Dober gives her words of encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Mejiro Dober's words ringing in her ears, Air Groove heads to her debut race determined to live up to the younger student's expectations.
